chunks: And yet they say: "You, to whom this Exposition has been sent are surely possessed of the Devil."
ai.seo_question: What did the disbelievers say about Prophet Muhammad when the Quran was revealed to him?
ai.summary: In Surah Al-Hijr, this verse highlights the psychological resistance of the Quraysh, who dismissed the Quran's eloquence as madness rather than divine truth, a motif recurring in the stories of previous prophets. Shia exegesis often links this to the concept of *'Aql* (intellect) being veiled by *Hawa* (desire), illustrating how the elite rejected the Imamate and Prophethood due to arrogance. This accusation serves as a precursor to the broader theme of *Tahzib* (purification) of the Prophet's message amidst societal rejection.
